title: Figure 7 (20610): witness hand drawing of five lights in a row above a vehicle
description: Framed scan of a witness sketch showing five evenly spaced circles in a horizontal row high above a horizon line, with a small car drawn on the ground at lower left; a handwritten note and the case number "20610" are written vertically at the left edge. Caption: "Figure 7 (20610) Hand drawing provided by witness. Witness indicated that he thought there were darker areas between the lights signifying an extremely large object." The investigator adds that unlit areas next to lights would look that way at night and that there is "No proof here of an object."
